paragraphs: BI Incorporated makes electronic monitoring technology for community corrections. The devices are used to supervise people on parole, probation or pretrial release rather than holding them in custody.

Location tracking, alcohol detection and radio frequency monitoring units are designed, engineered and manufactured in Boulder, Colorado. One described use is pretrial supervision, where judges and pretrial agencies need to hold people accountable while they await trial. Another is alcohol testing ordered in divorce, custody or visitation cases where a parent's drinking is in question.

The company says it has worked in community corrections for over 45 years. It reports more than 1,000 professionals on staff, including technicians, software engineers, assembly workers and call center representatives. Its monitoring specialists handle alerts and calls for more than 1,000 agencies. The company states that its monitoring solutions are certified by DNV to ISO 9001-2015. Agencies and courts can buy or rent equipment through cooperative purchasing agreements.

quote.text: BI proudly designs, engineers, and manufactures location tracking, alcohol detection, and RF monitoring units in Boulder, Colorado.
